description: A web application that lets users browse movies, add them to a personal watchlist, rate and review titles, and track their watch history.
target_users: Movie enthusiasts who track what they watch
Film critics who write detailed reviews
Friends who share watchlists and ratings
core_features: Browse and search a catalog of movies
Add movies to a personal watchlist
Rate and write reviews for watched movies
View personal watch history with ratings
future_features: Share watchlists and reviews on social media
Personalized movie recommendations based on ratings
Import and export watchlist data via CSV

milestones: Set up repository and development environment
Develop core UI pages (login, register, catalog, detail, watchlist)
Add social sharing integration for watchlists and reviews
Implement recommendation engine based on user ratings
Provide CSV import/export for watchlist data
Write unit and integration tests for all modules
Set up CI/CD pipeline and automated deployments
Perform UI/UX refinements and mobile responsiveness
Monitor performance and fix any post‑launch issues
